skill.name: zhihu-content-research
skill.description: 当用户需要做知乎热门话题观察、热门选题参考、关键词研究、竞品内容对比、趋势判断或素材整理时使用。面向内容运营、品牌调研和创作者。
skill.summary: Research public Zhihu topics and compare content samples with source links and engagement signals when available.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most backtick matches are Markdown formatting, and the entropy findings reflect Chinese prose rather than concealed code. The guide directs users and agents to run an unpinned CLI that receives or accesses credentials, and its search example lacks safe argument handling. No evidence of embedded secrets, credential exfiltration, or an attempt to manipulate this audit was found in the supplied files.

remediation.issue: Unpinned CLI download and execution during credential checks, setup, and research
remediation.suggestion: Replace the moving release tag with an approved version and verify package integrity before execution. Obtain explicit approval before installing dependencies and isolate the runtime from unrelated credentials.

remediation.issue: User-supplied search terms are shown inside shell command text
remediation.suggestion: Pass keywords and page tokens as separate arguments to an approved executable without invoking a shell. Prefer an approved MCP connection with typed arguments where available.

remediation.issue: The CLI handles credentials from environment variables and a persistent local file
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a scoped credential managed by an approved secret store. Verify access controls and ensure status and error output never reveal credential values.

remediation.issue: The workflow resumes credit-consuming requests after a top-up without a separate approval step
remediation.suggestion: Check the approved request budget before continuing. Ask the user before resuming a paid request outside that budget.

content.value_statement: Finding relevant Zhihu discussions and comparing them takes time. Review current hot topics and focused search samples in a report with sources and engagement signals.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve the current Zhihu hot list without a keyword and report available ranks and popularity signals.
Search public Zhihu content by keyword and filter results by content type or publication window.
Use supported search sorting options, including recency and upvotes.
Collect a bounded sample across pages and flag partial results.
Summarize content angles and retain available titles, authors, links, and visible engagement data.
limitations: Requires an authenticated SocialDataX connection or CLI. API requests may consume service credits.
Search results are a sample, not a full archive or a measure of all activity on Zhihu.
Titles, links, author details, and engagement figures depend on what the service returns.
The research tools do not post, vote, comment, or modify Zhihu accounts.

use_cases.title: Choose Topics for the Editorial Calendar
use_cases.description: Review the hot list for relevant discussions and identify questions worth covering.

use_cases.title: Compare Brand Discussions
use_cases.description: Search two brand names with the same filters and compare content angles and visible engagement.

use_cases.title: Find Questions for a New Article
use_cases.description: Review recent answers for repeated questions and identify where a new article could add useful detail.

prompt_templates.title: Review the Hot List
prompt_templates.prompt: Show five topics from the current Zhihu hot list. Include each topic's rank and link if available.

prompt_templates.title: Sample Recent Answers
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Zhihu for answers about standing desks from the past month. Use one page and summarize recurring questions with source links where available.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Public Brands
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare public Zhihu articles about Xiaomi and Huawei from the past month. Use one page per keyword with the same sorting and note differences in coverage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare content in matched samples.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research public Zhihu discussions about home energy storage. Use at most two search pages and 15 results. Flag partial coverage, cite available sources, and propose questions for follow-up.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Prepare a brief with explicit evidence limits.

output_examples.input: Summarize three consumer technology topics from today's Zhihu hot list.
output: Illustrative example only: The sample covers three entries from one hot-list page.
The topics concern phone battery life, laptop repair, and smart home compatibility.
For a follow-up article, look for questions about how long devices receive software updates.

output_examples.input: Summarize recurring questions in one page of recent Zhihu answers about standing desks.
output: Illustrative example only: The sample uses the standing desk keyword, the answer filter, and a one-month publication window.
Common questions concern height adjustment, frame stability, and shared workspaces.
These themes reflect one returned page and do not establish which questions are most common across Zhihu.

best_practices: Start with one page and set a clear page or item limit before expanding the search.
Record the query, filters, sample size, and source links so others can check your conclusions.
Use an approved connection, send only public search terms, and keep credentials out of chat.
anti_patterns: Treating one result page or hot-list snapshot as representative of all Zhihu users.
Entering a real API key into chat, a command argument, or a shared document.
Repeating requests after a billing error or resuming paid calls without checking the approved budget.

faq.question: Do I need a keyword to view the hot list?
faq.answer: No. The current Zhihu hot list is a separate request. Use a keyword for focused searches.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a configured SocialDataX credential. An authenticated hosted MCP connection can use its existing authentication without local CLI setup.

faq.question: Can I filter or sort keyword search results?
faq.answer: Yes. Search can filter by content type and publication window. It can use default ranking, recency, or upvotes for sorting.

faq.question: Can this skill find every Zhihu post about a topic?
faq.answer: No. It reports the pages returned for your query. Results can be partial and are not a complete archive.

faq.question: Can this skill publish content or change a Zhihu account?
faq.answer: No. The research tools read public results and do not post, vote, comment, or modify accounts.

faq.question: What should I do if the service runs out of credits?
faq.answer: Review the partial results and check your balance in the SocialDataX dashboard. Confirm your budget before resuming rather than retrying immediately.
